hk.label: Heating circuit
hk.description: Heating circuit: pump, mixing valve, flow and room temperatures, heating curve and solar discharge settings.

ww.label: Hot water
ww.description: Domestic hot water circuit: sensors, pump and solar discharge settings.

pu.label: Buffer tank
pu.description: Buffer tank: temperature sensors, loading pump and request to the boiler.

sk.label: Solar circuit
sk.description: Solar circuit: collector and tank temperatures, pump and status.

boiler.label: Existing boiler
boiler.description: Back-up boiler (oil, gas...) driven by the controller: temperature, burner contact and pump/valve output.

weather.label: Weather
weather.description: Weather data and forecast used by the controller to anticipate sunny days.

fa.label: Pellet boiler
fa.description: Pellet boiler: combustion, fans, augers and fill levels. Empty on installations without a pellet boiler.

p2h.label: Power2heat
p2h.description: Power2heat: surplus electricity turned into heat.

system.label: Controller
system.description: The controller: outdoor temperature, plant mode (summer / winter), errors and general values.

descriptions.LOCAL.L_ke_brennerkontakt_1: Burner request sent by the controller to the existing boiler. On = the burner is running.
descriptions.LOCAL.L_ke_temp_ist: Temperature measured by the existing boiler's sensor (terminal X13).
descriptions.LOCAL.L_ke_temp_soll: Setpoint of the existing boiler (8 °C = no request).
descriptions.LOCAL.L_bestke_umschaltventil: Dry contact (terminal X24) that starts the existing boiler's pump or changeover valve.
descriptions.LOCAL.L_hk[0].mischer: Mixing valve of the heating circuit: stopped, opening or closing. Three-point control, there is no position feedback.
descriptions.LOCAL.L_hk[0].vorlauftemp_ist: Heating flow temperature measured after the mixing valve.
descriptions.LOCAL.L_hk[0].vorlauftemp_soll: Heating flow temperature wanted. The buffer setpoint is this value plus the overshoot setting. 8 °C = heating off.
descriptions.LOCAL.L_hk[0].raumtemp_ist: Room temperature measured by the room unit.
descriptions.LOCAL.L_hk[0].raumtemp_soll: Room temperature wanted at this moment (comfort or setback, remote offset and eco mode included).
descriptions.LOCAL.L_pu[0].einschaltfuehler_ist: Buffer tank, top sensor (switch-on sensor): the boiler is requested when it falls below its setpoint.
descriptions.LOCAL.L_pu[0].ausschaltfuehler_ist: Buffer tank, middle sensor (switch-off sensor): the boiler stops when it reaches its setpoint.
descriptions.LOCAL.L_ww[0].einschaltfuehler_ist: Hot water switch-on sensor (the highest sensor of the buffer tank).
descriptions.LOCAL.L_sk[0].speichertemp_ist: Temperature at the bottom of the tank, where the solar coil is.
descriptions.LOCAL.L_aussentemperatur_ist: Outdoor temperature used by the controller.
descriptions.LOCAL.hk[0].solarheiz_temp_ein: Solar discharge: starts when the top of the buffer reaches this temperature and sun is forecast.
descriptions.LOCAL.hk[0].solarheiz_temp_aus: Solar discharge: stops when the buffer falls below this temperature, which keeps a hot water reserve.
descriptions.LOCAL.hk[0].solarheiz_mode: Schedule = follows the time program. Solar pump = only while the solar pump is running.
descriptions.LOCAL.ww[0].solarheiz_temp_ein: Solar discharge towards hot water: start temperature.
descriptions.LOCAL.ww[0].solarheiz_temp_aus: Solar discharge towards hot water: stop temperature.
descriptions.LOCAL.hk[0].ueberhoehung: The buffer setpoint is the flow setpoint plus this margin. Lowering it delays the boiler.
descriptions.LOCAL.hk[0].vorlauftemp_max: Highest flow temperature the heating circuit may ask for (and so the buffer setpoint minus the overshoot).
descriptions.LOCAL.hk[0].vorlauftemp_min: Lowest flow temperature of the heating circuit.
descriptions.LOCAL.hk[0].heizkurve_fusspunkt: Flow temperature at 15 °C outdoors; changing it shifts the whole curve.
descriptions.LOCAL.hk[0].heizkurve_steigung: Change of the flow temperature for each degree of outdoor temperature.
descriptions.LOCAL.hk[0].heizgrenze_heizen: During comfort periods, heating is cut above this average outdoor temperature.
descriptions.LOCAL.hk[0].heizgrenze_absenken: During setback periods, heating is cut above this average outdoor temperature.
descriptions.LOCAL.anlage_betriebsart: Winter = heating and hot water. Summer = hot water only.
descriptions.LOCAL.L_weather_forecast_clouds: Cloud cover forecast for the day the controller looks at; the eco mode lowers the heating when it is below its limit.
descriptions.LOCAL.L_weather_forecast_temp: Temperature forecast for that same day.
descriptions.LOCAL.L_weather_forecast_today: Which day the forecast is about: today or tomorrow (it switches after the end of the forecast window).
descriptions.LOCAL.L_weather_time_start: Start of the daily period in which the controller reads the forecast (HH:MM).

solar.intro: On sunny days the comfort setpoint is raised so the buffer's solar surplus heats the house, without the boiler; it is put back as soon as one condition fails.
solar.settingsHint: Change them in Settings > Devices & services > ÖkoFEN Portal > Configure.

history.empty: Nothing in Home Assistant's history for the last 48 h: the panel reads the recorder for its entities (burner, tank, collector, flow, room…). Check they are enabled and recorded.
